grade_rationale: 3 P1 findings (exceeds C threshold of 2) and ~14% full-scope spec coverage (below C threshold of 40%). Active Plans-level traceability is 100%; the gap is structural — the primary Specifications/ files are not covered by the traceability enforcer.

backlog.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md — 69 formal FRs with 0% implementation coverage
backlog.detail: This file contains FR-001 through FR-069 describing a SQLite-backed platform. The project pivoted to a Self-Judging Workflow Engine. Zero source files reference these FRs. The traceability enforcer never scans Specifications/, so this gap is invisible to CI.
backlog.recommendation: (a) Archive as _archived/dev-workflow-platform.md, or (b) add [DEFERRED] header and exclude from traceability gate. Update inspector.config.yml specs.dir to reflect active spec set.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer scoped to Plans/ only — Specifications/ is a CI blind spot
backlog.detail: The enforcer auto-selects the most recent requirements.md under Plans/. It never reads Specifications/. inspector.config.yml sets specs.dir: Specifications/ but the enforcer ignores it — making any FR in Specifications/ structurally exempt from enforcement.
backlog.recommendation: Add --specs-dir flag to enforcer to scan Specifications/. Or formally deprecate Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md and document the policy.
